description: Defines the BBinder class implementing the IBinder interface, along with related classes BpRefBase and internal Stability, for Android's binder IPC mechanism.

classes.name: BBinder
classes.description: Implementation of the IBinder interface for Android's binder IPC.

classes.name: BpRefBase
classes.description: Base class for proxy objects holding a remote IBinder reference.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the interface descriptor string.

methods.name: isBinderAlive
methods.description: Checks if the binder is alive.

methods.name: pingBinder
methods.description: Pings the binder to check connectivity.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the binder state to a file descriptor.

methods.name: transact
methods.description: Performs a transaction with the binder.

methods.name: linkToDeath
methods.description: Links a death recipient to the binder.

methods.name: unlinkToDeath
methods.description: Unlinks a death recipient from the binder.

methods.name: attachObject
methods.description: Attaches an object to the binder.

methods.name: findObject
methods.description: Finds an attached object by ID.

methods.name: detachObject
methods.description: Detaches an object by ID.

methods.name: withLock
methods.description: Executes a function with the binder lock held.

methods.name: lookupOrCreateWeak
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a weak reference to an object.

methods.name: localBinder
methods.description: Returns the local BBinder instance.

methods.name: isRequestingSid
methods.description: Checks if requesting SID.

methods.name: setRequestingSid
methods.description: Sets the requesting SID flag.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Gets the extension binder.

methods.name: setExtension
methods.description: Sets the extension binder.

methods.name: setMinSchedulerPolicy
methods.description: Sets the scheduler policy and priority.

methods.name: getMinSchedulerPolicy
methods.description: Gets the scheduler policy.

methods.name: getMinSchedulerPriority
methods.description: Gets the scheduler priority.

methods.name: isInheritRt
methods.description: Checks if real-time inheritance is enabled.

methods.name: setInheritRt
methods.description: Sets the inheritance of real-time scheduling.

methods.name: getDebugPid
methods.description: Returns the process ID for debugging.

methods.name: wasParceled
methods.description: Checks if the binder was parceled.

methods.name: setParceled
methods.description: Marks the binder as parceled.

methods.name: setRpcClientDebug
methods.description: Sets RPC client debug info.

methods.name: startRecordingTransactions
methods.description: Starts recording transactions.

methods.name: stopRecordingTransactions
methods.description: Stops recording transactions.

methods.name: ~BBinder
methods.description: Destructor for BBinder.

methods.name: onTransact
methods.description: Handles incoming transactions.

methods.name: remote
methods.description: Returns the remote IBinder pointer.

methods.name: remoteStrong
methods.description: Returns a strong reference to remote IBinder.
